When user_count is a multiple of limit (e.g. 50/50), this yields 2 pages with the second empty; correct formula is Math.ceil. judged_text: Off-by-one in totalPages (admin-group.js.es6): Math.floor(user_count / limit) + 1 yields an extra empty page whenever user_count % limit == 0 (50 members with limit 50 shows '1/2'; 100/50 yields 3 pages with the last one empty), so showingLast is false on the real last page and next navigates to an empty page where offset clamps to user_count; the correct formula is Math.ceil(user_count / limit)

record.issue_text: Off-by-one in totalPages (admin-group.js.es6): Math.floor(user_count / limit) + 1 yields an extra empty page whenever user_count % limit == 0 (50 members with limit 50 shows '1/2'; 100/50 yields 3 pages with the last one empty), so showingLast is false on the real last page and next navigates to an empty page where offset clamps to user_count; the correct formula is Math.ceil(user_count / limit)

adjudication.rationale: In `admin-group.js.es6`, `totalPages` is computed as `Math.floor(this.get("user_count") / this.get("limit")) + 1`, which overcounts when `user_count` is an exact multiple of `limit` (e.g., 50/50 => 2 pages). This makes `showingLast` false on the real last page and allows `next` to advance `offset` to `user_count` (`Math.min(offset+limit, user_count)`), and `Group.findMembers` then requests `offset == user_count`, yielding an empty member list page.
